name: furniture
description: Furniture atlas (家具图鉴): 20 pieces from one generator — bed/table/chair/stool/sofa/bookshelf/cabinet/kitchen_counter/desk/lamp_post/flower_pot/bench/dresser/fireplace/piano + wardrobe/fridge/bunk_bed (家具造法图鉴) + bathtub/bathroom_sink 卫浴线 (图片造法提炼). All recipes are build-circle canon; direction states (stair facing/half, sign rotation, bed/door part, trapdoor open/half, waterlogged) derived from origin+facing by the script.
when_to_use: Interior furnishing after walls/roof. origin = bottom-FRONT-left cell at floor level (the cell the piece stands IN); facing = front direction (seats: sitter's view; bed: foot->head = where the pillow points). DIRECTION STATES ARE SCRIPT-DERIVED — never hand-edit facing/half/rotation/part in output; change params and re-run (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 室内家具/软装:卧室(bed/bunk_bed/dresser/wardrobe/bookshelf)、客厅(sofa/table/chair/stool/bench/lamp_post/flower_pot/piano)、书房(desk/bookshelf)、厨房(kitchen_counter/cabinet/fridge)、壁炉客厅(fireplace)、卫浴(bathtub/bathroom_sink)

origin.notes: bottom-front-left cell; y = the layer the piece stands in

extra.notes: see pieces.<name>.params; all have safe defaults, default output = the classic recipe

bed.recipe: REAL <color>_bed: part=foot at origin, part=head one cell forward (same facing); default adds a bottom-slab headboard above the head cell (图鉴 §2.1)

params.posts: true = four-poster fence frame, default false

pitfalls: 必须用真床方块(part=foot/head),严禁羊毛/混凝土冒充(项目耻辱柱)
head 格前方必须是空气否则放置失败

table.recipe: fence leg(s) + pressure-plate top; top=cloth swaps plate for carpet 桌布(图鉴 §2.2)
pitfalls: 桌面默认 pressure_plate;carpet 桌布选 top=cloth
width>1 每格一条腿,不要只放两端腿

chair.recipe: one stair (back at rear: stair facing = OPPOSITE of sitter's view) + armrests; arm=trapdoor uses closed side trapdoors (图鉴 §2.4)
pitfalls: 楼梯 facing 必须=坐向反面,放反人面朝靠背
扶手 sign 是站立式,rotation 脚本推导

stool.recipe: style=stair: bare stair; style=bar: fence post + top slab 高脚凳(图鉴 §2.4)
pitfalls: stool 无靠背;要靠背用 chair/sofa

sofa.recipe: stair row (backs at rear) + end stairs as arms with tall side OUTWARD; cushion=<color> 加羊毛坐垫; back=true 加活板门靠背(向后多占 1 格,勿贴墙用)(图鉴 §2.4)
pitfalls: 扶手端楼梯背朝外(高侧在外)
整排座位共享一个 facing

bookshelf.recipe: bookshelf grid; trim=true caps with a slab strip(图鉴 §2.6 层板)
pitfalls: 禁用空 chiseled_bookshelf(空架纹理像烂柜);塞满书的可用但生成必须带满书 NBT(图片提炼 9ff2 满架观感好)

cabinet.recipe: style=barrel: barrel grid, lids facing out = cupboard doors; style=shelf: bookshelf body + closed trapdoor lid on top(图鉴 §2.5); style=banner: barrel grid + 前排每格挂 wall banner 当现代柜门(图片提炼 e850,向前多占 1 格)
pitfalls: barrel 盖朝正面;朝上读作木墩
别和 chest 混用(两两合并破坏网格)
banner 柜门贴墙摆放勿用(门排在正面 w=-1)

kitchen_counter.recipe: cauldron sink + half=top stair counter run + smoker oven; faucet=true 在水槽后墙格加 lever 水龙头(仅贴墙)(图鉴 §2.7); curtain=true 在水槽+台面正面挂条纹 banner 挡布(图片提炼 e850,向前多占 1 格)
pitfalls: 台面楼梯必须 half=top
灶用 smoker 不是 furnace
挡布不罩 smoker 格

desk.recipe: style=slab: half=top stair desk + lectern; style=study: barrel 抽屉墩+楼梯桌面+bookshelf 侧架+lectern+盆栽(图鉴 §2.3 builditapp 复刻)
pitfalls: 桌体楼梯 half=top
lectern 在桌体正上方,手挪即悬空

lamp_post.recipe: style=fence: fence column + lantern; style=end_rod: 竖叠末地烛现代落地灯(图鉴 §2.8)
pitfalls: 灯放柱顶不贴墙
height≤4,再高是路灯

flower_pot.recipe: minecraft:potted_<plant>; pedestal=true 加 fence 底座
pitfalls: 盆栽是 potted_* 独立方块,不是 flower_pot 上叠花
椅面 slab 必须 type=bottom
要靠背用 sofa

dresser.recipe: barrel column grid (lids = drawer fronts) + slab top
pitfalls: barrel 盖朝正面
顶面 slab type=bottom 搁桶上

fireplace.recipe: campfire firebox + half=top stair lintel arch + brick breast + chimney column
pitfalls: 火用 campfire,禁 netherrack 点火
过梁 half=top 架火上;烟囱直通屋顶

piano.recipe: dark body + white_concrete keys strip at front + stair lid sloping toward player
pitfalls: 琴键必须在 facing 正面且被琴身夹住

wardrobe.recipe: 2-wide planks body + double doors in the FRONT row (hinges toward middle = handles meet mid) + half=top stair cornice
pitfalls: 门在正面前一排,depth=2;origin 仍是柜体前排左格
双门 hinge 必须朝中间,反了把手分居两侧

fridge.recipe: 2-high iron_block body + iron_door in front cell (可开) + stone_button handle
pitfalls: 铁门必须用按钮/拉杆开,depth=3(体+门+按钮),别贴墙放正面

bunk_bed.recipe: real bed at floor + fence posts rising at head/foot columns + second real bed on top (y+3); style=storage(图片提炼 62f6): 上铺右侧竖开活板门护栏 + 床尾正面梯子 + 床头后 2 宽 3 高 barrel 整体柜(向后多占 1 格)
pitfalls: 上下铺都用真床方块
上铺上方至少留 1 格空气(spawn 规则)
storage 护栏/梯子别贴墙贴人行走道放

bathtub.recipe: 2 宽 × length 缸体: 每格 half=top 楼梯朝外+waterlogged=true 围成盛水盆(水在方块状态里,无水源方块); faucet=true(默认)在后沿墙格放 tripwire_hook 龙头(贴墙摆放)
pitfalls: 盛水靠 waterlogged 状态,禁止放真 water 方块(外溢且淹地板)
faucet 在背面 w=length 墙格,非贴墙摆放设 faucet=false

bathroom_sink.use_for: 浴室水槽/洗手台(新,图片提炼 b8f3;8f12 的 minecart 台盆是实体无法 setblock,降级为 waterlogged 楼梯盆)
bathroom_sink.recipe: 白台身 + half=top waterlogged 石英楼梯台盆 + 后墙格 tripwire_hook 龙头(默认开) + sea_pickle 皂盒; mirror=true 挂白 banner 镜, towel=true 挂蓝 banner 毛巾(均需后墙)
pitfalls: 龙头/镜/毛巾都在背面 w=-1 墙格,非贴墙摆放全关掉
waterlogged 楼梯盆已含水,别再叠水源
床必须用真床方块(part=foot/head)——羊毛冒充床是项目耻辱柱,严禁再犯
所有朝向状态(stair facing/half、sign rotation、bed/door part、trapdoor half/open、lever/button face)由脚本从 origin+facing 推导,禁止手填
坐具楼梯 facing=坐向反面;台面/桌面楼梯 half=top;座面 slab type=bottom 贴地
扩占地的细节全是 opt-in 参数(sofa back、kitchen faucet/curtain、cabinet banner、storage 双层床)——interior_rooms 贴墙摆放只用默认形态
tripwire_hook = 通用水龙头/龙头件(图片提炼 6887/b8f3/e850/1392 四图互证),卫浴/酒桶/厨台水龙头统一用它;waterlogged 楼梯/半砖 = 安全盛水容器,别放真水方块
家具不浮空:每件有落地支撑路径,跑 support_check/slab_check 验证
example: python patterns/furniture.py --params '{"piece":"bed","origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"east"}' --out bed.json && python patterns/furniture.py --params '{"piece":"wardrobe","origin":[100,64,110],"facing":"south"}' --out wardrobe.json
